scenario: Routine cash contribution and domestic grant
resolve: payment settles; remittance delivered

scenario: Appreciated publicly traded securities contribution
detect: ContributionReceived from custodian; intent reference match
resolve: units issued at NAV; acknowledgment lists shares not value

scenario: Complex privately held asset (closely held stock / LP interest / real estate)
detect: ContributionIntentDeclared with complex asset class → acceptance case
contain: no units issued until accepted and transferred
escalate_to_human: complex asset specialist; gift acceptance committee above threshold; CFO valuation
resolve: accept with liquidity plan or decline; 8283 signed; 8282 tracked
residual_risk: valuation and liability judgment; excess business holdings

scenario: Donor recommends ineligible recipient (revoked / private non-operating foundation / individual)
escalate_to_human: only if donor disputes or ER path chosen
resolve: decline with reason and alternatives; or ER path for eligible non-charity

scenario: Suspicious / potentially fraudulent transaction (account takeover then grant to new recipient)
detect: fraud score + new-recipient velocity + device change
escalate_to_human: fraud analyst to release or confirm
resolve: donor confirms via prior channel or account locked and recovered
residual_risk: authorized-push fraud by a deceived real donor

scenario: Grant involving potential private or prohibited benefit (tickets / tuition / pledge)
detect: BenefitRisk agent flag; purpose-text rule; relationship graph
resolve: approve with restriction / decline / donor revises
residual_risk: undetected benefit where no textual signal exists

scenario: Large volume of simultaneous recommendations (year-end or disaster-relief spike 10x)
contain: D path scales; fan-out caps hold anomalous excess; exception queue prioritized
escalate_to_human: COO staffing surge for exception queue only
resolve: backlog drained; twin pre-sizing
residual_risk: exception queue latency for non-routine grants

scenario: Market disruption requiring liquidity management
contain: grants paid from cash buffer; rebalancer constrained to liquidity floor
escalate_to_human: Investment Committee for playbook beyond bounds
resolve: raise liquidity per IPS playbook

scenario: Custodian outage
contain: trading suspended; contributions queued; grants from cash buffer within limits; donor status banner
escalate_to_human: COO incident; CFO if beyond RTO
resolve: reconcile backlog on restore

scenario: Incorrect AI recommendation (agent mis-resolves recipient or misses a flag)
detect: donor confirmation step; sampling (CTL-040); drift monitor (CTL-027)
contain: agent output is proposal only; deterministic gates still run
resolve: retrain/fix via CTL-026; reprocess affected
residual_risk: false negatives (missed flags) not caught by gates

scenario: Compromised partner API credential
contain: token revoked; partner scope suspended; requests in flight re-validated
escalate_to_human: CISO declares incident; GC notification analysis
resolve: rotate credentials; review requests made during window
residual_risk: data exposure within scope before revocation

scenario: Attempted unauthorized payment (insider or direct call to payment path)
detect: payment gate denial; KMS alarm on non-gate caller
resolve: access revoked; forensic review

scenario: Regulatory inquiry (IRS exam or state AG letter)
resolve: decision bundles produced with evidence index

scenario: External financial statement audit
resolve: auditor queries evidence API; recomputes NAV/fees/reconciliations

scenario: Donor dispute (grant declined or delayed; fee disagreement)
escalate_to_human: service recovery specialist; program officer for policy disputes
resolve: explain with decision record; goodwill credit within authority

scenario: Financial reconciliation discrepancy (custodian position ≠ ledger)
contain: NAV held if material (CTL-017); trading on affected pool paused
resolve: root cause; correcting entry or custodian correction

scenario: Key technology provider failure (core platform vendor or model provider exits)
contain: model provider: agents degrade to D-path + human queue; platform: cold standby restore
resolve: switch provider via exit-readiness

scenario: Board-level governance conflict (director related to vendor or major donor)
resolve: decision by disinterested directors with comparables

scenario: Prompt injection via charity website text into discovery or benefit-risk agent
detect: red-team eval; output schema anomaly; flag-rate drift
contain: agent cannot clear flags or write state
resolve: patch prompt/tool isolation; add case to eval set

scenario: IRS data feed stale or unavailable
contain: D path refers instead of passes; payments of already-approved grants continue
escalate_to_human: grants compliance lead to approve degraded-mode policy
resolve: restore feed or alternate source

scenario: Mass eligibility / discretionary hold controversy (SPLC-style 2026 holds; multistate AG letter)
detect: CharityEligibilityChanged (none) vs reputational trigger; donor demand spike
escalate_to_human: CEO per hold; board for policy; GC for AG response
resolve: documented decision; periodic review; consistent application
residual_risk: legal and reputational exposure either way

scenario: Payee bank-account hijack (BEC impersonating nonprofit)
resolve: verify via previously verified contact; restore old profile
